script_text:
Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury, your ruling planet of Air, is in the third house of communication, while the Sun in Scorpio opposes the Moon in Gemini, forming a tense Full Moon opposition that stirs your eighth house of shared secrets. This opposition is tightening your fuse in the tenth.

Your love life is getting a deep check. With this aspect activating your seventh house, a long-held misunderstanding with your partner may explode, or if you're single, you'll attract a Cancer or Pisces energy through intense mental chemistry.

In career and money, your tenth house is being squeezed by Mercury in the third, so don't sign contracts or start a side hustle impulsively.

Avoid gossip before noon, but an unexpected financial surprise from an old connection could land.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
